G3100.def: from «3101»; intransitively, to become a pupil; transitively, to disciple, i.e. enrol as scholar:--be disciple, instruct, teach.

G3103.def: of Hebrew origin («04968»); Mathusala (i.e. Methushelach), an antediluvian:--Mathusala.

G3104.def: probably of Hebrew origin; Mainan, an Israelite:--Mainan.

G3105.et: middle voice from a primary mao (to long for, through the idea of insensate craving)
G3105.def: middle voice from a primary mao (to long for; through the idea of insensate craving); to rave as a "maniac":--be beside self (mad).

G3106.def: from «3107»; to beatify, i.e. pronounce (or esteem) fortunate:--call blessed, count happy.

G3107.et: a prolonged form of the poetical makar (meaning the same)
G3107.def: a prolonged form of the poetical makar (meaning the same); supremely blest; by extension, fortunate, well off:-- blessed, happy(X -ier).

G3108.def: from «3106»; beatification, i.e. attribution of good fortune:--blessedness.

G3109.def: from «3110»; Macedonia, a region of Greece:--Macedonia.

G3110.def: of uncertain derivation; a Macedon (Macedonian), i.e. inhabitant of Macedonia:--of Macedonia, Macedonian.

G3111.def: of Latin origin (macellum); a butcher's stall, meat market or provision-shop:--shambles.

G3112.et: feminine accusative case singular of (3117) ((3598) being implied)
G3112.def: feminine accusative case singular of «3117» (3598 being implied); at a distance (literally or figuratively):--(a-)far (off), good (great) way off.

G3113.def: adverb from «3117»; from a distance or afar:--afar off, from far.

G3114.def: from the same as «3116»; to be long-spirited, i.e. (objectively) forbearing or (subjectively) patient:--bear (suffer) long, be longsuffering, have (long) patience, be patient, patiently endure.

G3115.def: from the same as «3116»; longanimity, i.e. (objectively) forbearance or (subjectively) fortitude:--longsuffering, patience.

G3116.def: adverb of a compound of «3117» and «2372»; with long (enduring) temper, i.e. leniently:--patiently.

G3117.def: from «3372»; long (in place (distant) or time (neuter plural)):--far, long.

G3118.def: from «3117» and «5550»; long-timed, i.e. long-lived:--live long.

G3120.def: of uncertain affinity; soft, i.e. fine (clothing); figuratively, a catamite:--effeminate, soft.

G3121.def: of Hebrew origin («04111»); Maleleel (i.e. Mahalalel), an antediluvian:--Maleleel.

G3122.et: neuter plural of the superlative of an apparently primary adverb mala (very)
G3122.def: neuter plural of the superlative of an apparently primary adverb mala (very); (adverbially) most (in the greatest degree) or particularly:--chiefly, most of all, (e-)specially.

G3123.et: neuter of the comparative of the same as (3122)
G3123.def: neuter of the comparative of the same as «3122»; (adverbially) more (in a greater degree)) or rather:--+ better, × far, (the) more (and more), (so) much (the more), rather.

G3124.def: of Hebrew origin («04429»); Malchus, an Israelite:--Malchus.

G3126.et: of Aramaic origin (confidence, i.e. wealth, personified)
G3126.def: of Chaldee origin (confidence, i.e. wealth, personified); mammonas, i.e. avarice (deified):--mammon.

G3127.def: of uncertain origin; Manaen, a Christian:--Manaen.

G3128.def: of Hebrew origin («04519»); Mannasses (i.e. Menashsheh), an Israelite:--Manasses.

G3129.et: prolongation from a primary verb, another form of which, matheo, is used as an alternate in certain tenses
G3129.def: prolongation from a primary verb, another form of which, matheo, is used as an alternate in certain tenses; to learn (in any way):--learn, understand.

G3131.def: of Hebrew origin («04478»); manna (i.e. man), an edible gum:--manna.

G3132.et: from a derivative of (3105) (meaning a prophet, as supposed to rave through inspiration)
G3132.def: from a derivative of «3105» (meaning a prophet, as supposed to rave through inspiration); to divine, i.e. utter spells (under pretense of foretelling:--by soothsaying.

G3133.def: of uncertain affinity; to extinguish (as fire), i.e. (figuratively and passively) to pass away:--fade away.

G3134.pos: 1. our Lord cometh or will come
G3134.et: of Aramaic origin (meaning our Lord has come)
G3134.def: of Chaldee origin (meaning our Lord has come); maranatha, i.e. an exclamation of the approaching divine judgment:--Maran-atha.

G3136.def: probably of Chaldee origin (meaning mistress); Martha, a Christian woman:--Martha.

G3137.def: of Hebrew origin («04813»); Maria or Mariam (i.e. Mirjam), the name of six Christian females:-- Mary.

G3138.def: of Latin origin; Marcus, a Christian:--Marcus, Mark.

G3139.def: from marmairo (to glisten); marble (as sparkling white):--marble.

G3140.def: from «3144»; to be a witness, i.e. testify (literally or figuratively):--charge, give (evidence), bear record, have (obtain, of) good (honest) report, be well reported of, testify, give (have) testimony, (be, bear, give, obtain) witness.

G3141.def: from «3144»; evidence given (judicially or genitive case):--record, report, testimony, witness.

G3142.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of «3144»; something evidential, i.e. (genitive case) evidence given or (specially), the Decalogue (in the sacred Tabernacle):--to be testified, testimony, witness.

G3143.def: middle voice from «3144»; to be adduced as a witness, i.e. (figuratively) to obtest (in affirmation or exhortation):--take to record, testify.

G3144.def: of uncertain affinity; a witness (literally (judicially) or figuratively (genitive case)); by analogy, a "martyr":-- martyr, record, witness.

G3145.et: from a primary masso (to handle or squeeze)
G3145.def: from a primary masso (to handle or squeeze); to chew:--gnaw.

G3148.et: probably from the base of (3145) (through the idea of contact)
G3148.def: probably from the base of «3145» (through the idea of contact); a whip (literally, the Roman flagellum for criminals; figuratively, a disease):--plague, scourging.

G3149.def: from the base of «3145»; a (properly, female) breast (as if kneaded up):--pap.

G3150.def: from «3151»; random talk, i.e. babble:--vain jangling.

G3151.def: from «3152» and «3004»; an idle (i.e. senseless or mischievous) talker, i.e. a wrangler:--vain talker.

G3152.def: from the base of «3155»; empty, i.e. (literally) profitless, or (specially), an idol:--vain, vanity.

G3153.def: from «3152»; inutility; figuratively, transientness; morally, depravity:--vanity.

G3154.def: from «3152»; to render (passively, become) foolish, i.e. (morally) wicked or (specially), idolatrous:--become vain.

G3155.et: accus. of a derivative of the base of (3145) (through the idea of tentative manipulation, i.e. unsuccessful search, or else of punishment)
G3155.def: accusative case of a derivative of the base of «3145» (through the idea of tentative manipulation, i.e. unsuccessful search, or else of punishment); folly, i.e. (adverbially) to no purpose:--in vain.

G3156.def: a shorter form of «3164»; Matthaeus (i.e. Matthitjah), an Israelite and a Christian:--Matthew.

G3157.def: of Hebrew origin («04977»); Matthan (i.e. Mattan), an Israelite:--Matthan.

G3158.def: probably a shortened form of «3161»; Matthat (i.e. Mattithjah), the name of two Israelites:--Mathat.

G3159.def: apparently a shortened form of «3161»; Matthias (i.e. Mattithjah), an Israelite:--Matthias.

G3160.et: probably a shortened form of (3161) cf (04992)
G3160.def: probably a shortened form of «3161» (compare «4992»); Mattatha (i.e. Mattithjah), an Israelite:--Mattatha.

G3161.def: of Hebrew origin («04993»); Mattathias (i.e. Mattithjah), an Israelite and a Christian:--Mattathias.

G3162.def: probably feminine of a presumed derivative of «3163»; a knife, i.e. dirk; figuratively, war, judicial punishment:--sword.

G3163.def: from «3164»; a battle, i.e. (figuratively) controversy:--fighting, strive, striving.

G3164.et: middle voice of an apparently root word
G3164.def: middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to war, i.e. (figuratively) to quarrel, dispute:--fight, strive.

G3165.et: a shorter (and probably originally) from of (1691)
G3165.def: a shorter (and probably originally) from of «1691»; me:--I, me, my.

G3166.et: from a compound of (3173) and aucheo (to boast, akin to (837) and (2744))
G3166.def: from a compound of «3173» and aucheo (to boast; akin to «837» and «2744»); to talk big, i.e. be grandiloquent (arrogant, egotistic):--boast great things.

G3167.def: from «3173»; magnificent, i.e. (neuter, plural as noun) a conspicuous favor, or (subjectively) perfection:--great things, wonderful works.

G3168.def: from «3167»; superbness, i.e. glory or splendor:--magnificence, majesty, mighty power.

G3169.def: from «3173» and «4241»; befitting greatness or magnificence (majestic):--excellent.

G3170.def: from «3173»; to make (or declare) great, i.e. increase or (figuratively) extol:--enlarge, magnify, shew great.

G3172.def: from «3173»; greatness, i.e. (figuratively) divinity (often God himself):--majesty.

G3173.et: [including the prolonged forms, feminine megale, plural megaloi, etc., cf also (3176), (3187)]
G3173.def: (including the prolonged forms, feminine megale, plural megaloi, etc.; compare also «3176», «3187»); big (literally or figuratively, in a very wide application):--(+ fear) exceedingly, great(-est), high, large, loud, mighty, + (be) sore (afraid), strong, × to years.

G3176.def: superlative of «3173»; greatest or very great:--exceeding great.

G3177.def: from «3326» and «2059»; to explain over, i.e. translate:--(by) interpret(-ation).

G3178.def: apparently a primary word; an intoxicant, i.e. (by implication) intoxication:--drunkenness.

G3179.def: from «3326» and «2476»; to transfer, i.e. carry away, depose or (figuratively) exchange, seduce:--put out, remove, translate, turn away.

G3180.def: from a compound of «3326» and «3593» (compare "method"); travelling over, i.e. travesty (trickery):--wile, lie in wait.

G3181.def: from «3326» and «3725»; bounded alongside, i.e. contiguous (neuter plural as noun, frontier):--border.

G3182.def: a prolonged (transitive) form of «3184»; to intoxicate:--be drunk(-en).

G3183.def: from «3184»; tipsy, i.e. (as noun) a sot:--drunkard.

G3184.def: from another form of «3178»; to drink to intoxication, i.e. get drunk:--drink well, make (be) drunk(-en).

G3185.def: neuter of «3187»; (adverbially) in greater degree:--the more.

G3187.def: irregular comparative of «3173»; larger (literally or figuratively, specially, in age):--elder, greater(-est), more.

G3190.def: of uncertain origin; Meleas, an Israelite:--Meleas.

G3191.def: from a presumed derivative of «3199»; to take care of, i.e. (by implication) revolve in the mind:--imagine, (pre-)meditate.

G3193.def: from «3192»; relating to honey, i.e. bee (comb):--honeycomb.

G3194.def: of uncertain origin; Melita, an island in the Mediterranean:--Melita.

G3195.et: a strengthened form of (3199) (through the idea of expectation)
G3195.def: a strengthened form of «3199» (through the idea of expectation); to intend, i.e. be about to be, do, or suffer something (of persons or things, especially events; in the sense of purpose, duty, necessity, probability, possibility, or hesitation):--about, after that, be (almost), (that which is, things, + which was for) to come, intend, was to (be), mean, mind, be at the point, (be) ready, + return, shall (begin), (which, that) should (after, afterwards, hereafter) tarry, which was for, will, would, be yet.

G3196.def: of uncertain affinity; a limb or part of the body:--member.

G3197.et: of Hebrew or (04428) with pronominal suf., my king
G3197.def: of Hebrew origin (4428 with pronominal suffix, my king); Melchi (i.e. Malki), the name of two Israelites:--Melchi.

G3198.def: of Hebrew origin («04442»); Melchisedek (i.e. Malkitsedek), a patriarch:--Melchisedec.

G3199.def: a primary verb; to be of interest to, i.e. to concern (only third person singular present indicative used impersonally, it matters):--(take) care.
